title: City-Data input
description: One city or a list. Field groups match the local city-data scraper.

cities.title: Cities
cities.description: Objects with city, state, and optional slug. Overrides city + state when set.

city.title: City
city.description: Single city name, used when cities is empty.

state.title: State
state.description: Two-letter state code for the single-city form.

slug.title: Slug override
slug.description: Optional city-data path token for the single-city form.

fields.title: Field groups
fields.description: Groups to parse. Crime also fetches the crime page.

delaySeconds.title: Delay between requests (seconds)
delaySeconds.description: Pause between page loads. Default 1.5, same as the local CLI.

maxCities.title: Max cities
maxCities.description: Optional cap on how many cities from the list are scraped.

maxSpendUsd.title: Max spend (USD)
maxSpendUsd.description: Stop when the next result, proxy, or CAPTCHA event would pass this amount. Default 5, maximum 100. Later rows are saved and are not billed.

maxProxyCostUsd.title: Max proxy spend (USD)
maxProxyCostUsd.description: Cap on proxy events alone. Default 0.50, clamped to maxSpendUsd. The first city page stays direct. A proxy retry happens only after a block, and only when this cap and maxSpendUsd both still have room. 0 skips the proxy retry.

allowCaptcha.title: Allow CAPTCHA solving
allowCaptcha.description: Default false. When false, a challenge after the proxy retry pushes a blocked row and exits without a solve charge. When true, a solve is attempted only if that proxy retry is still a challenge and maxSpendUsd covers the captcha event. This Actor does not ship a solver, so an unconfigured solve pushes blocked and is not billed.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy group
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy group used only after a direct page is blocked. Leave Apify Proxy off so the first attempt stays direct. Empty groups use datacenter.

proxyGroups.title: Proxy groups
proxyGroups.description: Optional group names, such as DATACENTER or RESIDENTIAL. Used after a block when proxyConfiguration has no apifyProxyGroups.
